runtime_style.visual_system: Monumental institutional modernism: one approved subject held in ceremonial stillness within original repeated concrete modules, strict axes, low viewpoints and pale-versus-black tonal masses.
runtime_style.mood_line: Ceremonial stillness beneath architecture that feels larger, colder and more ordered than the individual.
runtime_style.environment: An original non-recognisable brutalist complex using circular ceiling wells, repeated desk or rail rhythms, vertical ribs, raw slabs, columns, stairs and deep structural voids.
runtime_style.lighting: Use only the two observed states: green-olive diffuse top light for the institutional hall, or warm hard side light on exterior concrete; a shell wide may add directional opening light through environmental haze.
materials: raw cast concrete with seams, pores and restrained rust streaks
chrome or stainless rails and desk legs with pale matte tabletops
dark matte floor and deep concrete voids
abstract glass-and-metal architectural modules without copying the source building
runtime_style.contrast: Deep near-black anchors oppose pale concrete and aperture highlights; olive interiors keep muted midtones while warm exteriors retain a soft highlight roll-off.
runtime_style.expression_signature: Cheekbones at rest, no smile, lids neutral to low, chin level, mouth closed or softly parted, and gaze directed sideways, past the lens or deliberately withheld.
runtime_style.garment_behaviour: Approved items stay opaque and still: structured layers hold broad folds and volume, long layers hang plumb, and only real free edges may move; never copy source uniform, mask, strap or accessory design.
optical_signature: Every frame is optically clean and rectilinear with crisp architectural edges and no swirl, chromatic fringe or vignette.
No added flare, halation or global diffusion; retain concrete and textile microcontrast.
Atmospheric haze is allowed only as a physical environment layer in the shell wide, never as a lens change.

clean_identity_hero.camera_consequence: Vertical profile portrait from slightly below face level; repeated upright ribs fill one side while pale sky provides negative space.
clean_identity_hero.pose_joint_chain: Torso in profile, shoulders lowered, neck long, chin level, head looking off-frame, with both arms quiet below the crop.
clean_identity_hero.focus: Approved subject face and near shoulder sharp; vertical ribs and distant roof blocks fall gently softer.
clean_identity_hero.foreground: No foreground occluder; preserve a clean subject-to-architecture separation.
provenance: frame-04.jpg — profile chain, warm side light, rib field and clean foreground

environmental_hero.camera_consequence: Central-axis vertical from seated chest or eye height; circular ceiling modules dominate above compressed repeating desk rows.
environmental_hero.pose_joint_chain: Pelvis centred on a chair, knees separated and feet grounded, shoulders still, arms resting, neck rotating the head sideways with chin level.
environmental_hero.focus: Front approved subject is sharp; desk rows and anonymous non-identifying background figures fall progressively softer.
environmental_hero.foreground: A pale desk rail or tabletop may frame the lower edge without hiding the subject.
provenance: frame-01.jpg — seated central axis, ceiling wells, row compression and gradual focus falloff

sculptural_three_quarter.camera_consequence: Low level frontal-to-three-quarter composition inside stacked raw slabs; the approved subject anchors a triangular still formation.
sculptural_three_quarter.pose_joint_chain: Feet planted, pelvis square to slight three-quarter, spine upright, shoulders low, hands clasped below waist, chin level and head just off-axis.
sculptural_three_quarter.focus: Approved subject and nearest formation plane sharp; upper ledges and deep voids remain readable but secondary.
sculptural_three_quarter.foreground: No object crosses the lens; neighbouring shoulders may tighten the lateral frame without covering the approved subject.
provenance: frame-05.jpg — low monumental formation, clasped-hand chain and raw concrete depth

interference_frame.camera_consequence: Horizontal frontal table portrait on a strict centre axis with a shallow background and repeated ceiling circles.
interference_frame.pose_joint_chain: Approved subject seated square, elbows slightly open, both forearms forward, hands planted wide on the table, head visible and held still.
interference_frame.focus: Hands, approved subject and central clipboard plane are sharp; repeated background rows are deliberately softer.
interference_frame.foreground: A pale tabletop fills the lower quarter and one near desk device intrudes at frame left, slightly softer under the fixed clean no-flare, no-halation optic.
provenance: frame-02.jpg — tabletop edge, near device interference, planted hands and soft symmetric rows

material_or_accessory_detail.camera_consequence: Very low upward human-context detail; an approved hand-held item rises through the frame against abstract pale geometry and sky.
material_or_accessory_detail.pose_joint_chain: Torso remains present, one shoulder-elbow-wrist chain raises the approved accessory while the opposite hand stabilises it near the body.
material_or_accessory_detail.focus: Approved accessory surface, gripping hand and adjacent torso detail are sharp; architecture softens behind.
material_or_accessory_detail.foreground: The approved accessory occupies the near central plane but keeps a hand, wrist, shoulder or torso visibly attached.
provenance: frame-03.jpg — low accessory scale, gripping hands, warm metal response and human body context

wide_campaign_coda.camera_consequence: Distant level horizontal wide; a diagonal concrete stair divides deep bays while the approved subject remains at least thirty percent of frame height.
wide_campaign_coda.pose_joint_chain: Full standing chain in profile or three-quarter with feet grounded, torso upright, one elbow bent and wrist raised in a precise repeated gesture.
wide_campaign_coda.focus: Approved subject and near structural plane stay legible; haze reveals opening-light shafts through deeper bays.
wide_campaign_coda.foreground: Dark empty floor forms a low foreground band without occluding the body.
provenance: frame-06.jpg — distant level wide, diagonal stair, repeated hand gesture, deep bays and environmental haze

camera_lens.prompt: Create a 3-by-2 illustrated grid titled INSTITUTIONAL MODERNISM — CAMERA & LENS. Every panel must contain a large anonymous featureless JOINTED ARTIST MANNEQUIN wearing a plain opaque full-coverage neutral jumpsuit image in its upper half and exactly four short text lines below it: SLOT + SOURCE, CAM, FOCUS, FG. No table, no extra narrative paragraph, no empty mini-frame. Copy these concise panel lines exactly. Panel 1: CLEAN IDENTITY HERO — frame-04.jpg; CAM: SLIGHTLY-LOW TRUE SIDE PROFILE; FOCUS: FACE + NEAR SHOULDER SHARP, RIBS SOFT; FG: NONE. Panel 2: ENVIRONMENTAL HERO — frame-01.jpg; CAM: CENTRED SEATED AXIS; FOCUS: SUBJECT SHARP, ROWS PROGRESSIVELY SOFT; FG: PALE DESK EDGE, NEVER COVER SUBJECT. Panel 3: SCULPTURAL THREE-QUARTER — frame-05.jpg; CAM: LOW MONUMENTAL THREE-QUARTER; FOCUS: SUBJECT + NEAR PLANE SHARP, VOIDS SECONDARY; FG: NOTHING CROSSES LENS. Panel 4: INTERFERENCE FRAME — frame-02.jpg; CAM: FRONTAL TABLE, CENTRE AXIS; FOCUS: HANDS + FACE + CLIPBOARD SHARP, ROWS SOFT; FG: TABLETOP + SOFT NEAR-LEFT DEVICE. Panel 5: MATERIAL OR ACCESSORY DETAIL — frame-03.jpg; CAM: VERY LOW ACCESSORY WITH BODY CONTEXT; FOCUS: ACCESSORY + GRIP + TORSO SHARP; FG: ACCESSORY NEAR, MANNEQUIN WRIST + SHOULDER + TORSO ATTACHED, HEAD OPTIONAL. Panel 6: WIDE CAMPAIGN CODA — frame-06.jpg; CAM: DISTANT LEVEL WIDE, DIAGONAL STAIR; FOCUS: SUBJECT + NEAR STRUCTURE LEGIBLE, DEEPER HAZE; FG: DARK FLOOR BAND, NO OCCLUSION, SUBJECT AT LEAST 30 PERCENT HEIGHT. Panel 6 composition lock: place one full-body jumpsuited mannequin on the near stair landing in the middle distance, and make the mannequin fill ONE THIRD of the panel image height from feet to head; the figure must be obviously large and readable, never tiny, never far-background and never empty architecture. Use original non-recognisable architecture and anonymous mannequins only. Below the grid print FIXED OPTIC: RECTILINEAR; CRISP MICROCONTRAST; NO FLARE, HALATION, SWIRL, CHROMATIC FRINGE, VIGNETTE OR GLOBAL DIFFUSION; PHYSICAL HAZE ONLY IN SHELL WIDE. Print UNKNOWN: FOCAL LENGTH, APERTURE, SHUTTER, CAMERA MAKE, NUMERICAL HEIGHT, NUMERICAL FOCUS DISTANCE. Print exact Master Gamma once: #0C0E0C #2F332B #626452 #9EA293 #C6C4B0 #FDFEFD #C5A87B #7C908B #8A6539. Fully legible text only; do not paraphrase or add prose. No version number, no date, no invented metadata, no board codes, no photographer credits, no brand marks, no readable third-party text, no watermark.

blocking.prompt: Create a strict six-panel diagram board titled INSTITUTIONAL MODERNISM — BLOCKING & POSE. Use only featureless articulated mannequins and simple axis lines. Never invent a named pose. Copy these six qualitative joint chains exactly and place the source label directly under each panel. CLEAN IDENTITY HERO — frame-04.jpg: torso in profile, shoulders lowered, neck long, chin level, both arms quiet below crop. ENVIRONMENTAL HERO — frame-01.jpg: pelvis centred on chair, knees separated, feet grounded, shoulders still, arms resting, head turned sideways, chin level. SCULPTURAL THREE-QUARTER — frame-05.jpg: feet planted, pelvis square to slight three-quarter, spine upright, shoulders low, hands clasped below waist, chin level, head just off-axis. INTERFERENCE FRAME — frame-02.jpg: seated square, elbows slightly open, forearms forward, hands planted wide on table, head visible and still. MATERIAL OR ACCESSORY DETAIL — frame-03.jpg: torso present, one shoulder-elbow-wrist chain raises an approved accessory, opposite hand stabilises it near body. WIDE CAMPAIGN CODA — frame-06.jpg: full standing profile or three-quarter, feet grounded, torso upright, one elbow bent, wrist raised. Show shoulder-to-elbow-to-wrist and hip-to-knee-to-ankle chains where visible; mark hidden or unsupported joints UNKNOWN. Show camera axis and crop qualitatively; body-to-architecture distance and support side are UNKNOWN unless stated above. Do not print degrees, percentages, ratios, weight values, support values, asymmetry indexes, compression values or wind claims. No alternative poses. Anonymous spacing markers only; no copied body, face, uniform, mask, instrument, accessory design or building. Print the exact Master Gamma row once and exactly: #0C0E0C #2F332B #626452 #9EA293 #C6C4B0 #FDFEFD #C5A87B #7C908B #8A6539. Fully legible short labels only. No version number, no date, no invented metadata, no board codes, no photographer credits, no brand marks, no readable third-party text, no watermark.

garment_behaviour.prompt: Create an editorial specification board titled INSTITUTIONAL MODERNISM — GARMENT BEHAVIOUR. Use abstract neutral cloth studies attached to anonymous mannequin shoulders, wrists and hips; do not reproduce any source garment cut, pocket, strap, mask, uniform, accessory, colourway or logo. Panels: MOTION STATE — ceremonial stillness, no wind-driven action; AIR INTERACTION — long free layers hang plumb and only true free edges may shift; DRAPE/WEIGHT — structured approved items hold broad slow folds and their own volume, lighter approved items settle without ballooning; TRANSPARENCY — preserve the approved item's real opacity, never make opaque product sheer; EDGE QUALITY — crisp held edges with no motion blur; SURFACE RESPONSE — pale matte surfaces take broad highlights, dark matte surfaces retain low-detail folds without crushing; TRANSFER RULE — apply force and fold radius to the user's approved item, never the reference design. Cite frame-01.jpg through frame-05.jpg and frame-07.jpg; mark material composition UNKNOWN. Include the exact Master Gamma hex row: #0C0E0C #2F332B #626452 #9EA293 #C6C4B0 #FDFEFD #C5A87B #7C908B #8A6539. Crisp fully legible labels. No version number, no date, no invented metadata, no board codes, no photographer credits, no brand marks, no readable third-party text, no watermark.
